overview.purpose: Public marketing catalog for Japanese / western food ingredients distributed in Indonesia.
overview.authentication: NONE. No login, no API key, no session token, no cookies are required for any GET described here.
overview.stack_inferred: Laravel (XSRF-TOKEN / masuya_session cookies, Blade templates), jQuery 1.11 + 3.6, server-rendered HTML.
overview.transport: HTTPS, plain HTML GET requests. There is no public JSON product API.
overview.safety: All access in this project is read-only GET. Inquiry/contact POST endpoints exist on the site and are intentionally NOT used.

GET /product.description: Main product grid, server-rendered. 10 product cards per page.
GET /product.pagination: 62 pages, 613 unique products (61 full pages of 10 + 3 on page 62). Page 63 returns an empty grid.

GET /product?page=N.description: Paginated grid. Filters are preserved in the generated pagination links.

GET /product?keyword=TEXT.description: Server-side product search. Also matches descriptions/tags, so results are broader than name-only search.
GET /product?keyword=TEXT.minimum_input: Site search form in the header requires 3 characters; the product banner form has no such client-side limit.

GET /product?cat=B64ID&sub=B64ID.description: Subcategory filter. 39 subcategories across all categories.

GET /product?brand=B64ID[,B64ID...].description: Brand filter; the site's own JavaScript joins multiple checkbox values with commas. 119 brand values.

GET /SLUG.description: Product detail page. SLUG IS CASE-SENSITIVE (e.g. /q083m works, /Q083M returned 404 during recon; /C559M works). Always use the exact href from the listing.
GET /SLUG.response: text/html, ~189 KB (most of it is the shared inquiry popup and footer)

GET /sitemap.xml.description: XML sitemap with 422 <loc> entries: ~177 category/subcategory filter URLs, ~220 product-detail URLs, plus site, news and localized pages. It is noisier and less complete than the 613-product grid, which is the authoritative source. Sitemap slugs can differ in case from listing slugs.
GET /sitemap.xml.robots: https://masuya.co.id/robots.txt allows all and points to the sitemap.

GET /listProductCategory?page=N&url=prod.description: AJAX 'load more' used by the #loadMore button in js/product.js. Returns {"html":"...","loadmore":bool}. Without a browser session it returned {"html":"","loadmore":false}, so this project uses plain ?page=N instead.

GET /search?keyword=TEXT.description: Separate site-wide search page (news/recipes/pages), NOT the product grid. Returns no product-list__item cards. Not used by this MCP.

GET /produk.description: Indonesian-language alias of /product; renders the same 10-card grid.

GET /catalog-en.description: Catalog landing page. No downloadable PDF links were found in its HTML.

NOT USED (write / personal-data endpoint: POST /contact-us-product (product inquiry form, requires CSRF token + reCAPTCHA)
Any account, cart or checkout route
Google reCAPTCHA API (loaded by the page but never invoked by this project)

query_parameters.cat: Base64-encoded category id, e.g. MTg= (18 = Dairy). URL-encode '=' as %3D.
query_parameters.sub: Base64-encoded subcategory id, e.g. NDc= (47 = Cheese). Some values have no padding, e.g. MTQz (143).
query_parameters.brand: Base64-encoded brand id, comma-separated for multiple brands, e.g. MTMz (133 = Yamamotoyama).

id_encoding.format: base64 of the decimal database id, sometimes with '=' padding and sometimes without.
id_encoding.handling: Pass the encoded value through unchanged; the client exposes a decoded numeric id only for readability.

html_selectors.product_image: a.product-list__item figure img[src] (the filename's first token is usually the item code, e.g. 'DF0027  GF WHIPPING CREAM 1LT.png.webp')
html_selectors.pagination: div.pagination a[href*='page=']; the last numeric link is the final page (62)
html_selectors.category_tree: div.side-left__box--category ul li > a[href*='product?cat='] and nested li > a[href*='&sub=']
detail_quirks: Spec rows are sometimes duplicated (e.g. /ume-jelly) - deduplicate by label.
Some products have an empty description.
The detail page does NOT repeat the brand; it is joined from the listing card.
Most of the ~189 KB page is an inquiry popup / country dropdown; slice at div.product-detail.

published_product_fields: item code (derived from image filename or slug)

data_not_published.price: No prices anywhere. The site is inquiry-based; every product has a 'MAKE A INQUIRY' CTA.
data_not_published.origin: No country-of-origin field (brand names often imply it, but this is not confirmed data).
data_not_published.consequence: Price comparisons, ingredient-level substitution decisions and quality guarantees cannot be made from public data alone. Request specs and samples from a sales representative.

rate_limiting_and_ethics.observed: No rate limit or 429 was encountered while crawling 62 listing pages plus category pages.
rate_limiting_and_ethics.client_policy: 0.12 s minimum interval between requests, 2 retries, 25 s timeout, in-memory 10-minute HTTP cache, 7-day detail cache, and a bundled catalog_index.json snapshot so ordinary questions need zero new requests.
rate_limiting_and_ethics.scope: Only public GET requests to the pages listed above. No POST, no forms, no reCAPTCHA, no account data, no credentials.
rate_limiting_and_ethics.recommendation: Refresh the snapshot at most daily; scrape responsibly and respect robots.txt.

verification.keyword_cheese: 10 cards on page 1, includes Mozzarella Shredded Cheese Pouch (Greenfield), Ricotta Cheese, Kewpie Cooking Sauce Cheese Mayo, Nissin Gekikara Carbonara

comparison_with_sukanda_mcp.sukanda: Authenticated buyer API (JWT), prices, stock, purchase history, order data, ingredient composition.
comparison_with_sukanda_mcp.masuya: Public marketing catalog, no login, no prices, no stock, no order data, no ingredient composition.
comparison_with_sukanda_mcp.shared_use_case: Use Sukanda for buy/pricing decisions and Masuya for range discovery and alternative shortlists; never compare prices between them from public data.
